title: Amazing Crisp Middle Eastern Eggplant Baba Ganoush
description: A fatty and crisp Middle Eastern dish featuring parma ham and eggplant, perfect for festive occasions. This recipe combines the flavors of ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients in a delicious baba ganoush form.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: preferably black beauty or similar variety

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and score the flesh in a crisscross pattern.
Brush the eggplant with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Roast the eggplant in the oven for 30 minutes or until the flesh is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the eggplant from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Scoop the flesh out of the eggplant and transfer it to a blender or food processor.
Add the garlic, lemon juice, tahini, and a pinch of salt to the blender and blend until smooth.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the parma ham slices.
Cook the parma ham for 2-3 minutes on each side or until crispy and golden brown.
Stir in the blended eggplant mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the baba ganoush hot, garnished with crispy parma ham and a sprinkle of paprika.
